versions.changelog:
- Reduced Pro plan monthly price from $14.99 to $1.99.
- No other changes.

- Added a new freemium pricing section to the documentation.
- Described daily free query limits and updated premium (pro) plan features and details.

Initial release of News Sentiment Analyzer:

- Analyze crypto news and social media (Twitter, news, Reddit) sentiment.
- Provide bullish, bearish, and neutral sentiment scores.
- Generate trading signals and coin-specific sentiment analysis.
- Support for real-time updates and custom alerts.
- Utilizes APIs and LLM analysis for sentiment scoring.
